name: ImplicitTeardown
summary: Puts the cleaning up in a method the framework calls after every test, so that it happens whether the test succeeded, failed or threw.

roles.name: ImplicitTeardown
roles.summary: The tearDown the framework runs. Running after a failure is the property that matters: a test that cleans up at the end of its own body leaves the fixture behind precisely on the runs where somebody is about to investigate it.
